prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. I can recommend the best fit for you, but first I need a few details.

Quick questions
- What are your top goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, PR, etc.)
- What services do you need? (full‑service, digital/SEO, paid media, creative, social, B2B demand gen, web development)
- What’s your annual marketing budget (or monthly range)?
- What industry are you in and how big is your company? (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Do you prefer a local KC agency you can meet in person?

How I can help
- If you tell me the answers above I’ll research and give a tailored shortlist of 3–5 Kansas City agencies, with strengths, representative case studies, estimated pricing bands and questions to ask them.
- If you’d rather choose yourself, I can give a short checklist to evaluate agencies and point you to review sites (Clutch, Google Reviews, UpCity, local Chamber) where you can compare portfolios and client feedback.

Which would you prefer — a personalized shortlist, or the evaluation checklist and resources?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
